description: License compatibility check — Check open-source dependency licenses against your project. deps= name:SPDX-expression pairs separated by | (supports OR, AND, WITH exceptions, parentheses, common aliases like GPLv3/Apache 2.0); project= your outbound license (default proprietary; or MIT, GPL-2.0-only, AGPL-3.0-only...); use=distributed|saas|internal. Flags GPL/AGPL copyleft triggers, Apache-2.0 vs GPL-2.0-only, GPLv2-only vs v3, EPL-1.0/CDDL vs GPL, source-available licenses (SSPL, BUSL, Elastic, non-commercial), LGPL/MPL obligations. Returns per-dependency OK / NOTICE / REVIEW / CONFLICT with reasons, combined obligations and an overall verdict. Not legal advice. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: dev_license_compat
